chapter.heading: The LORD Reigns!(Psalms 99:1–9)
chapter.v:
The LORD
reigns! He is robed in majesty;the LORD has clothed and armed Himself with strength.The world indeed is firmly established;it cannot be moved.

Your throne
was established long ago;You are from all eternity.

The floodwaters
have risen, O LORD;the rivers have raised their voice;the seas lift up their pounding waves.

Above the
roar of many waters—the mighty breakers of the sea—the LORD on high is majestic.

Your testimonies
are fully confirmed;holiness adorns Your house, O LORD,for all the days to come.
